milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the cobblestone pyramid structure (center at ~8, 0, 6.5 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is at or very near the structure, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining brick_stairs with a pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no brick_stairs, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because it directly verifies the outcome.
